scores.evidence: The lesson has no decorative images and no diagrams. Code blocks s2-code (20 lines) and p1-model (16 lines) fit at 390 px without wrapping, and their highlighted lines are easy to see (pages/mobile-jp-06.png, pages/mobile-jp-20.png). The comparison of the three ways to run work in parallel (s1-table) and the flags (s3-table) are shown as lists, not as a figure or table.

metrics.json lists no text-only screens on desktop-jp or mobile-jp. Every screen has a heading, code block, steps, prompt or check. Desktop JP chars per line has a median of 37 (target 30–40). The longest prose block is s3-mode, which runs about 6 lines on mobile (pages/mobile-jp-10.png).

The lesson is JP-only and every screen is fully in Japanese, with English terms in parentheses on first use (s1-defs, s4-defs). The link text is specific: 「公式ドキュメント（非対話的実行）」 in s3-mode (pages/desktop-jp-07.png). No text is baked into images.

niceToHave: check-quiz e3 option d (`Bash(npm test *)` ＋ `dontAsk` だけ): on mobile, the trailing 「だけ」 breaks into だ / け (pages/mobile-jp-25.png). Rephrasing it as a full phrase, for example 「`--bare` を付けず、`Bash(npm test *)` ＋ `dontAsk`」, would avoid a split word.

p1-checklist labels show flags and patterns (--bare, Bash(npm test *), --permission-mode dontAsk) as bold proportional text, not as code (pages/mobile-jp-19.png, pages/desktop-jp-13.png). This makes them harder to match against the p1-model command. Shorter Japanese labels, or reader support for inline code, would help. reader: checklist labels do not render inline code.

The '用語・このレッスン' sidebar lists each term twice, for example 「ワークツリー（worktree）」 next to 「ワークツリー」 and 「バックグラウンド実行（background execution）」 next to 「バックグラウンド実行」 (pages/desktop-jp-01.png). It merges terms from the definitions blocks with the glossary. Making the s1-defs/s4-defs terms match the glossary entries would remove the duplicates; otherwise the reader should dedupe them (reader:).
reader: the p2-steps step 2 (p-rewrite) shows a 「うまくいかないときは」 toggle although the step has no troubleshoot text (pages/mobile-jp-21.png, pages/desktop-jp-14.png). Check what it opens.

reader: the full-length mobile-jp.png stops at 16000 px. Pages 01–31 cover the whole lesson. The end banner says this is the course's last lesson (expected for a draft). The failed /api/ requests are environment noise.
summary: No hard failures in metrics.json (no sideways overflow, no console, mermaid or image errors, no unknown blocks), and no screen shows personal data. Both code blocks and all quizzes are fully readable at 390 px with nothing cut off, and the steps and prompt blocks keep the rhythm varied. The remaining items are minor: a word split in exam option e3 on mobile, flags shown as plain text in p1-checklist, and duplicate glossary chips in the sidebar.
